analysis:
Integration pass over 23 units. The PR is mostly documentation (changelog.d entries, docs/architecture/inference.md, docs/developer/test.md, docs/provider/cli-reference.md, docs/reference/protocol-messages.md) and GLM5Next tests. It also contains a GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift change that was reviewed in earlier passes, and an opaque libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump from 7bed821 to 6aef0a5.

Behavior described as changed:
(1) Variable-frame-rate video is now indexed at i/nominalFrameRate instead of being refused. The documented bounds are unchanged: the 512 MiB decoded-frame cap (maximumDecodedBytes), the 28,532 visual-token cap, the 2 FPS sampler and the media reservation (GLM5NextVisionBudget). Media stays excluded from prefix lookup and capture, so T-041 cross-tenant KV reuse is unaffected.
(2) Returned OpenRouter reasoning/reasoning_details text is replayed as reasoning_content. This is consumer-controlled text in the consumer's own prompt, with the same trust as existing reasoning_content, and adds no cross-tenant channel.
(3) Strict tools are accepted, with each auto call validated via ToolConstraintValidation.validate before exposure. Empty-string tool arguments are read as {}.
(4) Looser null handling and a new `thinking` object form. Contradictory switches, unknown reasoning members, preserve_thinking, forced tool choices and hidden reasoning are still refused. Tests in GLM5NextPromptPolicyTests pin these fail-closed cases.

No change touches coordinator/provider crypto (TB-002), keys (A-002/A-003), App Attest authorization (TB-011, T-053), attestation, cache storage or the fan helper. No concrete regression is demonstrable from the supplied evidence.

Unverified items for human or later review, which are not findings:
(a) ToolConstraintValidation.validate must fail closed for strict tools. It is not in the supplied evidence.
(b) GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset must keep the frame-count, decoded-byte and time bounds for hostile VFR tracks (for example a wrong nominalFrameRate). The decoder source is not supplied.
(c) Replayed reasoning text should be checked against native-delimiter rejection. The impact is limited to the requester's own prompt.
(d) The mlx-swift-lm submodule bump is opaque. Its upstream diff and provenance need separate review, because it affects inference and possibly the prefix cache (T-041, TB-007).

Integration replay was incomplete (62 units omitted), so coverage is partial.
